The first fields, where the waypoint and market gather. No blade is drawn inside the village fence.
A dark trail lined with lightning-struck trees. Storm wraiths leap between the trunks.
A bandit den hides in the amber autumn grove. Old battlefield skeletons and pond ghosts stir as well.
A cold slope strewn with graves of a fallen fort. Skeleton soldiers stand guard in rows.
The stream that divides the village from the south. Mind your stamina when you swim.
A golden meadow at the foot of the old watchtower. Its guardian still stands.
Will-o'-wisps flare on the dry paddy banks. Bandits eye the harvest.

The wood of {0} has a fine grain. I chop every log around {1}. Lately folk in iron clothes keep coming to watch.
A strange air mixes into the wind of {0}. They say a rift opened in the sky and people from other times are crossing over.
Guarding {1} is my job. So many oddly dressed visitors these days, I can't tell who the bandits are.
Iron wheel tracks among the beast prints of {0}. Never seen marks like that in my life.
My map app doesn't show anywhere like {0}... but the view is amazing.
I have a parcel for {1}, but the recipient lived three hundred years ago. How do I get a signature?
A gang in gas masks is roaming around {0}. Don't travel alone.
Sampling the air of {0}. The time rift is open widest around here.
That stone pillar at {1} — stone outside, but inside it hums like a relay from my era.
{0}... I've only seen this place in records. Please keep it secret that I was here.
With one who knows righteousness, I will go anywhere.
Let's talk it over with a drink!
I will guard my lord with my life.
I will not forget the meaning of those three visits.
We share the same heart for the people.
I will lend you the spear of the western frontier.
Don't look down on me for being old!
I would rather betray the world than let the world betray me.
The one who knows how to wait is the one who wins.
Even with one eye, I see the enemy well enough.
I will hold off a hundred thousand with eight hundred.
You call me a king's right hand — I am honored and ashamed.
The east of the river welcomes those who know how to join hands.
When the southeast wind blows, our time has come.
Not hurrying is my art of war.
Let me show you my archery.
When you hear the bells, it is already too late.
Unrivaled under heaven! Who dares to stop me?
If I can be of help, then so be it.
If it saves lives, I will join you.
Beaten seven times, I rise an eighth!
Your servant still has twelve ships left.
Know contentment, and I advise you to stop here.
Everything is ready to break the river dam.
I will join the three kingdoms into one.
With five thousand I will face fifty thousand.
The walls of Liaodong will not fall.
So that the people may learn it easily and use it every day.
I will show you how to measure time by the sun's shadow.
I will carry on after Goguryeo.
My work is gathering again what was scattered.
I will lighten the people's burdens with a crane.
Before illness, what does rank matter?
I only put my heart into the tip of the brush.
A day without reading makes thorns grow in my mouth.
My only sorrow is having but one life to give to my country.
My only wish is complete independence.
All things are made by the mind.
I will fit this whole land onto a single sheet.
They say the invaders flee when they see the red robe.
Please remember the waves of the South River.
I set my mind right through reverence.
I hope the call for a hundred thousand soldiers was not too late.
You are right, and you are right too.
Though I die a hundred times over, my heart stays the same.
I rule the people's hearts with the way of spirits.
If you are not of the Heike, you are not a person.
I will open an age of warriors.
Even in my brother's shadow, my arrows never missed.
A fleeting world — I will leave it as a tale.
In spring, dawn is the loveliest.
Being a woman is no reason I cannot draw a bow.
A bird that will not sing gets cut down.
Heaven can be seized with talent, too.
Just wait until the cuckoo sings.
Swift as the wind, quiet as the forest.
I see no reason not to send salt to my enemy.
Even with one eye, I can see all under heaven.
The last spear of Osaka will be mine to hold.
A thousand days of practice, ten thousand days of training.
A shadow leaves no sound behind.
I will compile the history of this land.
Opening the gates is also a way to defend the country.
The world must be washed clean again.
I came, I saw, and now I will go with you.
Don't you want to see the end of the world?
If there is no road, cross the Alps and make one.
I mean to build a realm that holds both sword and letters.
Fear is not mine to keep. Raise the banner.
There is so much I have yet to paint.
I will turn a city of brick into one of marble.
I learned how to beat Magnaro from Magnaro himself.
Do not put off the good you can do today.
A lion's heart knows no retreat.
Once you cross the sea, you burn the ships.
I came from the north. Can you row?
A king is the first servant of the state.
We must open a window to the sea.
I am married to this country.
The nation expects each to do their duty.
If you cannot be loved, at least do not be scorned.
I merely stood on the shoulders of giants.
I only free what is already inside the stone.
I was queen of two kingdoms — let me do the counting.
Land won by the sword I will now rule by the law.
Faith is not won by force.
The gates of Jerusalem open to mercy as well.
I will build law and glory together.
I will put the workings of the body into a single book.
I will ride to the end of the world.
I will join the steppe and the heartland into one.
The more gold is shared, the more it is mine.
The short spear beats the long spear.
The Nile is still on my side.
The one who overturns the world — that is my name.
The stars foretold the arrival of strangers.
As long as there is a road, I will not stop walking.
An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth — carved in stone.
The scourge of heaven is here.

Report to the Elder of Cheongha
You came. These past few days the wind has been howling near the southern watchtower, and the stormclouds won't lift.
Since the old days, they say stormclouds come when something wicked awakens.
Go to the old watchtower in the Southern Glade. Rumor has it something fierce has made its nest there.
You beat the Warden? Hah, that brute was bewitched by the stormclouds too.
The stormclouds rise from the altar west along this bank. They say a serpent has slept there a long, long time.
There's a scholar reading the inscriptions at the ruins in the Northern Foothills. Go see her. Mind you, minions have been swarming the ruins' entrance lately.
I'm saved! Those minions wouldn't let me anywhere near the inscription.
Look here. 'Light the altar with elemental fire, and the name of the sleeper shall be revealed' — your power might just do it.
A stormcloud serpent… I thought that was only an old tale.
Thank you. Thanks to you, the village can breathe easier. Here's a small token the village gathered.
To face the serpent you'll need to grow stronger. Go gain more experience, then come back.
I've finished reading the inscription. The serpent sleeps inside the Stormcloud Altar, west along the Broad River.
When it wraps itself in lightning, it's weak to fire. Be well prepared!
The sky… it's cleared! First clear sky in years.
The serpent may wake again, but with you here I feel safe. I'd better prepare the feast!
Oh, Eunbi says she'd like to travel with you. Her knack for inscriptions should come in handy in a fight.

Report to the Elder of Cheongha
We've decided to hold a feast now that the sky has cleared. But we're short of hands.
Pick just three Cheongha orchids from the fields for me. They're flowers for the feast table.
Once you've picked them, cook a dish at the waystation pot too. I hear Ferryman Beodeul has lost his appetite lately.
Oh, that smells good! Looking after an old man like me.
But listen — last night the sky over the far farmland glowed red. The Ember Imp Chief is on a rampage again.
If that brute's embers ride the wind into the village, the feast and everything else will burn. Be careful.
You beat the Ember Imp Chief? Perfect timing. I found the second piece of the inscription.
'A masked traveler struck the altar and woke the sleeper' — the serpent didn't wake on its own.
The traveler may have left traces deep inside the Sleeping Tomb here in the foothills. Let's go.
Phew, without you the feast grounds would have been ashes.
A masked traveler… there was one in the old tales. They say he stood somewhere each time the stormclouds came.
Don't worry today — eat and enjoy yourself. Here's a gift for our feast guest.
It was the dawn after the feast. They say a masked traveler was standing at the southern bridgehead.
He answered no one and just stared at the river. Could he be the one from the old tales…
Be careful. If he is the one who stood there whenever the stormclouds came, no one knows whether he means well or ill.
……So you are the one who cleared the stormclouds.
Too many ears here. If you have something to say, follow me.
Think it over as we walk. Fall too far behind and I won't wait.
No one will hear us here. I am not the one who woke the serpent.
I am only chasing the one who goes about striking the altars. He wears a mask too — so everyone mistakes him for me.
Proof… those bushes over there look suspicious. It seems you were being followed too.
Not bad. Look at the masks these minions wore — the pattern differs from mine.
Show this piece to the scholar in the foothills. A girl who reads inscriptions will recognize it.
We'll meet again. Before the next stormclouds come.
A mask fragment? Let me see… this pattern is exactly the one carved at the bottom of the inscription!
The inscription says there are five altars. The Stormcloud Altar is just one of them.
I don't know yet. But once the pieces come together, we'll find out. I'll search the old road beyond the western pass first.
A masked one the traveler is chasing… you mean the stormclouds could come five more times?
I'm glad you're here. The villagers put this together for you — take it.
If sparks reach the feast, that would be a disaster.
Who would do such a thing?
So the real one is someone else?
The peak's summit — the traveler is visible on the plateau below
The Black Mask fled into the stormclouds
Wrong order — all the lanterns went out
Sun, moon, star — the seal is broken

Report to the Elder of Cheongha
It's been three days since Eunbi left for the old road in the western woods. We haven't heard a word since.
That road is older even than the shrine. It's buried in the forest now, and few remember it.
Head into the western wood path from the village and you'll reach the mouth of the old road. Hurry.
Phew, saved! The minions caught me red-handed while I was copying the inscription.
The second altar is at the north end of this wood path. Three lanterns surround it.
The inscription reads — 'The sun rises, the moon sets, the stars remain'. Light them in that order and the seal will break.
They'll all go out, I bet. Sun, moon, star — don't forget!
……That was nearly too late. He was on his way to strike this altar.
You lit the seal first, so he couldn't wake it — he just let his minions loose and fled.
Over the peaks. This is an inscription fragment he dropped — give it to the scholar.
……On the road chasing him, two will be better than one from now on. Once you've paid your respects to the Elder, I'll stand at your side.
The third piece…! 'When all five altars wake, the master of the stormclouds returns'.
The masked one isn't after the serpent. He's after that 'master'.
We've guarded two. The other three… I'll read more of the fragments and let you know.
I'm glad Eunbi is safe. The master of the stormclouds… just the name gives me chills.
You've even brought a forgotten road back to life. The village owes you a great deal. Take this.
I pieced the fragments together. The third altar is on the peak east of the Southern Glade — there's no path, so you'll have to climb the cliffs.
They say the traveler already went up. He saw the Black Mask heading there.
The real culprit, I mean. This time we have to catch him before he runs! Watch your stamina on the way up.
You came quickly. He'll be here to strike the altar any moment.
He clings to your back like a shadow. When a red circle appears under your feet, get out at once.
……He's come. When he wraps himself in stormclouds, break it with fire!
……He fled into the stormclouds. But his mask is cracked. Next time he can't hide.
This is an inscription fragment he dropped. And the altar — it bears the marks of his strikes, but it's still alive.
Light the elemental fire again. The scholar will be up soon.
Huff, huff… who built this cliff? Let me see the fragment!
'The Stormcloud King sleeps divided among five altars. The mask is the mark of the King's servants'…
Yes. Two altars remain. He must be in a hurry too — let's warn the village first.
A servant of the Stormcloud King… there was something like that in a lullaby my grandmother used to sing.
You climbed all the way up the peak — well done. Are you hurt anywhere? The villagers put this together for you.
……This old one can't just sit around any longer. I'll come with you on the next journey. I can still stir up a breeze with my fan.
And if the order is wrong?
The Black Mask is one of them?
The more I read this inscription, the stranger it gets.
Fall too far behind and I won't wait.

Report to the Elder of Cheongha
There was a map carved on the back of the fourth fragment. The fourth altar is on the cape east of the river crossing, where the water curls around.
But it's strange. They say lights flicker back and forth on the cape every night. The old ferryman would know best.
The Black Mask might not come alone this time. Be careful!
The cape, you say? These past nights, masked hordes have been swarming toward it.
I can hear them pounding the altar stones from here. This old man's boat is no match for them.
Too many to count. Drive off one pack and another comes. Hurry, before the altar crumbles.
You came. He won't dirty his own hands this time — he sent the horde first.
If the altar crumbles, the fourth piece of the Stormcloud King will be set free. Don't let the horde reach the altar.
Watching from behind the waves, no doubt. Once the horde falls, he'll come out on his own.
……He fled into the water. But he left half his mask behind.
That face just now… no, it can't be.
I can't say yet. Relight the altar first — his strikes left deep marks.
The fire's lit! I saw it from afar and rowed over.
But do you see that? A light is blinking on the rocky isle across the water too.
The sea lane to the rocky isle is rough — no one goes there. Tell the Elder first.
……And I'll guide you along that sea lane. This old oar still has some use. Once you've paid your respects to the Elder, I'll stand at your side.
You held the altar… now only the rocky isle remains.
Half a mask, you say. And the traveler was that startled?
You've worked hard. The villagers gathered this when they saw the light on the cape.
Once the storm clouds lift, the village must throw a feast.
The water has smelled off lately.
Chapter 8 · The Fifth Altar on the Rock Isle
Hear about the Rock Isle from the elder
The light the ferryman saw on the Rock Isle — they say it burned even brighter at dawn today.
There is no way to the Rock Isle but by boat. Ask Ferryman Beodeul for a ride.
The old folk called it "the rock where the stars rest." If there is a fifth altar, it will be there.
Ask the ferryman at the river landing for a boat
A boat? Of course I'll take you… but my oar is gone!
Some quick-footed rascal just ran off along the bank with it on his shoulder. One of the masked gang's errand boys, no doubt.
You won't catch him walking — he's fast on his feet. You'll have to run for all you're worth!
Return the oar to the ferryman
Ha, you caught that quick little rascal? Your feet are something else too.
With my oar back, the Rock Isle is nothing. Hold on tight once you're aboard.
Take the ferryman's boat to the Rock Isle
Off we go! The current is strong, so keep your head down.
Drive off the masked gang atop the Rock Isle
Talk to the traveler on the isle
…I got here first. I knew he would come to this isle.
I suppose I must tell you now. The Black Mask's true name is Haesol — an old friend who grew up in my village.
Light the stone lanterns. Star, moon, sun — the order of the song Haesol sang as a child. That is how he would have locked it.
Light the fifth altar's lanterns in the order of Haesol's song
Talk to Haesol, who appeared by the lanterns
…Star, moon, sun. So someone still remembers that song.
The five altars are the locks that hold the King. And I am the key that opens them.
The traveler is looking for you.
That's none of your concern. I'll be waiting at the sixth seat above the storm clouds — we'll finish this there.
Mull over Haesol's words with the traveler
…As headstrong as ever. Walking off with half his mask broken.
The sixth seat above the storm clouds… I have heard tales of an island floating in the sky. The scholar will know.
Let us head back to shore for now. The ferryman is waiting with the boat.
Take the ferryman's boat back to the river landing
All done? Let us get back before the sun sets.
Report to the elder of Cheongha
Haesol… I never thought I would hear that name again. He and the traveler were inseparable as children.
The sixth seat above the storm clouds… let's ask Eunbi. Rest well tonight.
This is for your trip to the Rock Isle. The villagers each chipped in a little.
🏃 The thief bolts with the oar — run!
💨 Lost him — the thief slipped back to where he started. Get close and he will run again
🏃 You caught the oar thief — the oar is back

Chapter 9 · The Sixth Seat Above the Storm Clouds
Ask the wandering scholar about the sixth seat
I've pieced all five fragments together! The last line reads — 'Where the five fires meet, the sixth seat lies in the sky above the peak.'
And last night I saw a pillar of wind rising into the sky from the peak where the third altar stood. The lights of all five altars were gathering there.
Ride the wind and you should be able to climb above the clouds. The traveler already went to the peak — hurry!
Climb to the top of the peak
The summit — the traveler stands beside a pillar of wind rising into the sky
Talk to the traveler beside the wind pillar
You came. Do you see it — that pillar of wind? The fires of the five altars have opened a road to the sky.
Jump inside the pillar. The wind will spread your wings and carry you up onto the cloud isle.
…He will. This time I bring back Haesol, not the mask. I will go up first.
Ride the wind pillar up to the cloud isle (jump inside it)
Defeat the storm-cloud gang guarding the cloud isle
Face Haesol in the storm-cloud mask
Haesol, cloaked in storm clouds, descends from the sixth seat
Haesol raises a storm-cloud shield — break it with fire! A whirlwind hawk and a storm wraith leap in
Haesol's mask finally splits in two and falls away — Haesol drops to his knees
…Where… am I? It feels like I was dreaming for a long time. Someone in the storm clouds kept telling me to sing…
No — it's too late! The King's dream leaked out through the cracks I knocked into the locks. That dream is taking form on this isle!
My body won't obey me yet. You stop the Storm King. I'll hold the wind in place with my song.
The storm clouds gather into a crowned giant — the Storm King!
The Storm King raises a lightning shield — break it with fire! Two minions leap in
The Storm King — the dream scatters and the storm clouds clear from the sky
Go to the traveler and Haesol
Still wearing that mask, I see. A vow to find me, was it? You fool.
I suppose I can take it off now.
